suggested_change: Criterion 1: Define minimum evidence threshold—either (a) explicit 'Unknown/0/10' if only technical symptoms exist without quantified business impact, OR (b) require >1 business metric quote (revenue, volume, or timeline) to score ≥3/10. Criterion 5: Remove database-scale-as-ICP-proxy logic. Require actual SaaS product usage metrics (e.g., published traffic data, customer testimonials) or mark as 'Insufficient data' rather than assumed 100K+. Also: make Engineer-led deal without Product/Growth stakeholder an explicit disqualifier, not a risk flag.
